launch_binding.note: BIN hashed once at staging; --run re-hashes only the small files

pacing_dependencies._scope: local source closure only; third-party packages provenance-limited, not pinned

cwd.note: precedent cwd kept; recorded for any relative outputs (present_shot uses an absolute path)

own_cache.note: cold cache: startup compile load expected and recorded at run; no v68 cache

pack.note: every PNG sha-pinned by the candidate (files + emissive_files); emissive OFF; non-PNG files are not pinned by the candidate and are hash-recorded only; no immutable claim

hd_state: on from boot; no replacement-control; PROOF_CONTROL empty
